Name: Fruit Tree Fertilizer
Author: MD0uroa
Description:
An advanced, multi-purpose fertilizer tailored specifically for Fruit Trees in Stardew Valley 1.6+. Built using Content Patcher and Harmony, this mod offers a balanced yet powerful way to manage your orchard.

>🌟 Main Features:
- Instant Growth Boost: Every application instantly cuts 7 days off the tree's remaining maturity days.
- Bypass 3x3 Grid Restrictions: No more worrying about floorings, paths, or debris blocking your tree's growth! The fertilizer completely bypasses the vanilla grid restrictions.
- Balanced Mechanics: Limited to 2 applications per tree each game week to prevent it from being too over-powered.
- Visual Feedback: Uses standard grid indicator color (Green) when aiming at valid fruit trees.

> 🛠️ In-Game Requirements & Crafting:
- Unlock Requirement: Reaches Foraging Level 2 to automatically unlock the recipe.
- Crafting Recipe: 30 Clay, 5 Speed-Gro, and 3 Tree Fertilizer.

> 🔌 Requirements:
- SMAPI (v4.0.0+)
- Content Patcher

> 💖 Shout Outs:
- Big thanks to Pathoschild for creating SMAPI and the amazing ModBuildConfig tool.
- Special thanks to Andreas Pardeike for the incredible Harmony library that makes advanced code patching possible.
- Special thanks to the Stardew Valley Modding Community for the extensive documentation and wonderful support
